items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: And I had this Sandman with me that was on the tour with Basie with me and Tommy Tucker, blues singer, and I had Elaine... I put this show together.

ctx.x: Who made the hit on that?
Tommy Tucker got number one hit on it, just on the records. Then others followed up.

Well, there's one other thing about Kansas City I was going to say. What about -- I mean, Jay McShan, he has -- now, he has a sort of a pretty unique feeling, too, I always think. I always think he's very much underrated. He's -- it isn't quite like Basie's, but he does have a feeling for swing, doesn't he?
